“Los Angeles Fashion District GTO”).12 The Los Angeles Fashion District GTO applied
to certain specified types of “Covered Businesses,” including “perfume stores,” in a
“Covered Geographic Area” that encompassed A&S’s Fine Fragrance location at 501
East Olympic Boulevard.13

course of its trade or business, received currency in excess of $3,000 in one transaction
or two or more related transactions in a 24-hour period, to report such transactions
electronically to FinCEN.14 The Los Angeles Fashion District GTO was effective from
October 9, 2014 through April 6, 2015.

statutory.reasoning: Under 31 U.S.C. § 5324(a)(3), it is unlawful to structure a transaction or series of transactions to evade reporting requirements. The fact pattern shows multiple cash deposits just below the reporting threshold, specifically $9,003.88 on 2026-04-22, $9,629.97 on 2026-02-17, and $15,016.42 on 2026-03-28. While the total volume is near the declared monthly volume of $35,688, the repeated use of cash deposits just under $10,000 suggests an intent to evade reporting. This pattern of behavior is consistent with structuring as prohibited by 5324(a)(3).
